rationale: The momentum thesis that justified entry — a surging volume staircase to fresh highs — has completely stalled; the three post-entry candles show sharply declining volume (3,108 → 4,020 → 6,102 vs. the 17,735 entry bar) and price grinding sideways just above the 9-EMA with zero favorable excursion. The bid ($5.48) is already printing below the original invalidation level ($5.49), signaling the market is willing to trade through the stop, and with no news catalyst and a 35.96% gap increasing mean-reversion pressure, the asymmetry of holding has turned negative; a clean exit preserves the day's realized gains.
